title: El velorio
goal: Say the right thing at a wake, which is almost nothing
culture: The wake is in the house, all night, door open, chairs out in the street and coffee going. You go in, you say four words, you sit down for twenty minutes. Saying too much is the mistake. Not going at all is the bigger one, and it will be noticed.

beats.es: (La puerta está abierta. Hay sillas en la calle y café.)
beats.good: Four syllables, and then stop. The mistake at a wake is never saying too little.
Mi pésame is the fixed phrase, and using it says you know what to do — which at that door is worth a great deal more than sincerity you cannot express yet.

beats.es: Setenta y ocho años tenía. Se fue tranquilo, gracias a Dios.
beats.good: Buena gente is the highest ordinary praise there is here, and it is exactly what you say about somebody you did not know well. It is not a lie; it is the form.

beats.es: Aquí estamos, pues. Toda la noche vamos a estar.
beats.objective: Say you will stay a while
beats.say: Aquí estamos. Me quedo un rato.
beats.en: We’re here. I’ll stay a while.
ok: aqui estamos me quedo un rato
beats.good: Aquí estamos — we are here. It means what it says: nobody is going anywhere, and for the next twenty minutes neither are you.
